SOFTPHONE.TITLE: Softphone
SOFTPHONE.MINIMIZE: Minimize phone; keep the call connected
SOFTPHONE.NOT_CONFIGURED: Your extension has not been configured yet. Contact your administrator.
SOFTPHONE.OTHER_CALL_BUSY: Finish the current call before starting another.
SOFTPHONE.NOTIFICATIONS_DENIED: Call notifications are blocked. Allow notifications in your browser settings.

PABX.TITLE: PABX API settings
PABX.HELP: Read integration independent of SIP/WebRTC. Only Super Admin can configure. Saving does not test or synchronize.
PABX.PENDING: External integration validation is pending. CDR and recording mappings are provisional until a real response is validated.
PABX.HTTP_WARNING: Unencrypted HTTP: temporary LAB use requires explicit authorization. Prefer HTTPS.
PABX.ENABLED: Enable new API reads (does not change SIP softphone)
PABX.USERNAME: API user/email — leave blank to preserve
PABX.PASSWORD: API password — leave blank to preserve
PABX.PREFIX: Tenant prefix + extension (API only; never DTMF)
PABX.MAPPING: Provisional CDR field mapping (JSON; not validated externally)
PABX.SAVE_FIRST: Save before testing. Testing contacts the provider. Sync is separate and requires compatible scope.
PABX.SAVED: Settings saved. No read or sync was performed.
PABX.FAILED: Could not complete. Check settings and diagnostics. Secrets and raw responses are never displayed.
PABX.QUEUED: Sync queued through the existing job system. Check the latest success/error after execution.
PABX.TENANT_MISMATCH: Returned accountcode differs from the configured tenant. CDR and recordings were blocked.
PABX.HISTORY_EXTENSION: Human history extension (not the SIP username)
PABX.RECORDING_ERROR: Recording unavailable or access denied. Contact your administrator.
PABX.CHECK_PASSED: Configuration checks passed; external validation pending
PABX.CDR_CONTRACT_HELP: CDR identity is independent of SIP. Pagination quantity is 20; continuation remains blocked until its parameter and the populated row mapping are confirmed.
PABX.BY_LINK: Documented link from the stored CDR
PABX.RECORDING_FORBIDDEN: You are not authorized to access this recording.
PABX.HISTORY_LOADING_HELP: Call history will appear when the request finishes.

TRANSFER.ASSISTED_HELP: Dial *1 + extension to begin an assisted transfer and speak to the destination first.
TRANSFER.BLIND_HELP: Dial # + extension to transfer directly to an internal extension.

SETUP.TITLE: Make and receive calls in one place
SETUP.SUBTITLE: Set up a voice channel to start handling calls with your team. Every call, along with its recording, will appear here.

ROW.FAILED: This call could not be connected
